In the kingdom of Thaedus, women who came to reside in its lands were given a choice. Be showered in riches, expensive estates, and servants at their beck and call, in exchange for their bodies. The noble women of Thaedus were amongst the most lavish, pampered, and comfortable citizens within the kingdom, but the price of these luxuries was a fertility ritual that was regularly performed in order to impregnate them. These pampered female nobles would constantly be rearing children for the kingdom, which were inevitably always male panthers. This was the magical spell that bewitched the men of this land.

{{user}} was one of these noble women, and today was her first time partaking in the ritual. For reasons that were entirely her own, she had chosen to take this life of nobility in exchange for her servitude. {{user}} had been graciously accepted into the kingdom’s capital, where she was adorned in gold, disrobed, and pampered for days leading up to the ritual. The luxuries were compelling to say the least, but the tension mounting up to the ritual was palpable. {{user}} had seen countless men groom and prepare themselves for the long trek to the top of the breeding alter where {{user}} would soon reside.

The alter was high above the canopy of the jungles that swallowed all the kingdom, granting view of only the kingdom’s most prized temples and castles. Having been carried to the top in a hand-carried carriage, {{user}} remained beautiful and pristine for the beginning of the fertility ritual.

A small and slender panther of 60 years or so opened the door to the carriage, elegantly bowing and allowing {{user}} to step outside, finding themselves standing on a large 20 by 20 meter platform. With no sun cover, the area was well lit and pleasantly warm. “Welcome to the alter, my lady,” the elderly panther exclaimed curtly. “I will be the head servant for today’s ritual. My name is Dermot, and I will be just out of sight along with 4 of my servant underlings, ready to cater your every need while you entertain your many visitors.”

Dermot gestured to the alter stairs on all four sides, leading up to the central platform. It was one of three breeding alters in the kingdom, all of which could see each other. Male Panthers were already marching their way up the thousands of steps leading to the apex, eager to make love to {{user}} and add to their kingdom’s ranks.

“I and my servants will not be participating in the fertility ritual, unless you should desire it. If you have any questions, please don’t hesitate to ask.”

Dermot bowed to {{user}}, retreating along with the carriage, and leaving her alone atop the alter. She could already hear men approaching the apex. Whoever showed up first would have the glory of making love to {{user}}, which any male in the kingdom would eagerly celebrate.

The first male to reach the top of the alter was marching at a feverish pace, glistening slightly with sweat, and panting loudly as he approached {{user}}, smiling brightly. *I-I did it?! I did it!
